dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is rather pleasant here, far away from all the commotion. We needn't be in a hurry to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I would offer to paint your portrait since we have some time on our hands, but unfortunately I don't have my new palette on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose I could peruse one of the books here. Reading is a fine way to calm the mind.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is well worth exploring this domain thoroughly, though it will take some time. Approximately as long as it would take to read an entire alchemy book from cover to cover, in my estimation.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Perhaps I could assess each threat that awaits us, quantify the total effort required in each case, and... Hmm? From the look on your face... You wish to continue the battle now, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Then let's go. Remember to make each move count, and be ready to change strategy at a moment's notice.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I was reading an alchemy paper recently, and was particularly interested in the section on Targeted Integration of Hidden Effects of Composite Alchemical Ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Some details of the experiment weren't expounded on in full, although I was able to follow along and bridge most of the gaps. But I'm keen to learn more about what happens during the actual mixing stage. I'll have to take the time to recreate the entire experiment in full, then I can observe it for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh, you'd like to watch, too? Certainly. I'll let you know when I plan to conduct the experiment.
